title: Android Unlock Patterns
description: Calculate total number of valid patterns from length m to n on a 3x3 grid, skipping keys require intermediate keys to be visited.
pseudocode:
1. jump[1][3] = 2; jump[1][7] = 4; jump[1][9] = 5; 
2. function backtrack(curr, count, visited): 
3.   if count > n: return 0
4.   total = (count >= m ? 1 : 0)
5.   visited[curr] = true
6.   for next from 1 to 9:
7.     if !visited[next] && (jump[curr][next] == 0 || visited[jump[curr][next]]):
8.       total += backtrack(next, count + 1, visited)
9.   visited[curr] = false
10.  return total

steps.note: Starting recursion with pattern length 1 at node 1
Checking if node 2 is valid (no jump required)
